title: Tracecat 1.6.0-alpha.1
body_markdown:
## Case management


- feat(enterprise+cases): Save, share, and pin custom case views ([#4174](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4174) )
- fix(cases): Keep the original filename on attachment downloads ([#4201](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4201) )
- docs(cases): Document custom case views ([#4203](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4203) )
- fix(tables+cases): Let table row writes run concurrently per workspace ([#4216](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4216) )
- perf(cases): Read case field columns in one catalog query ([#4219](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4219) )


## Tables


- fix(tables): Take the semantic search lock shared on reads ([#4218](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4218) )
- perf(tables): Check embedding settings under the shared search lock ([#4221](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4221) )
- perf(tables): Lock one table instead of the workspace in indexer steps ([#4222](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4222) )


## Agents


- fix(agents): Retry managed LLM rate limits for up to a minute ([#4027](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4027) )
- fix(agents): Retry and classify LLM gateway connect timeouts ([#4110](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4110) )
- feat(agents): Disable Claude Code attribution header for non-Anthropic ([#4151](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4151) )
- fix(agents): Retry agent turns when the provider drops the stream ([#4178](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4178) )
- refactor(agents+engine): Share the worker-owned uvicorn server ([#4185](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4185) )
- fix(agents): Let workspace members act on workflow-started sessions ([#4207](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4207) )
- feat(agents+ui): Ask Slack for the scopes the Slack tools use ([#4210](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4210) )
- feat(agents+docs): Add Slack setup guides and link them in the app ([#4211](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4211) )
- feat(agents): Run stdio MCP servers through each agent backend ([#4213](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4213) )
- feat(agents): Remove agent tool call and request ceilings ([#4243](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4243) )


## Tracecat MCP


- chore(mcp): Require MCP tools for new features in AGENTS.md ([#4192](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4192) )
- fix(mcp): Accept private_key_jwt at the token endpoint ([#4195](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4195) )
- feat(enterprise+mcp): Expose per-org concurrency limits and usage ([#4248](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4248) )


## Core actions


- fix(actions): Parse +json responses as JSON in core.http ([#4202](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4202) )


## Integrations


- fix(integrations): Promote main builds deployed after an alpha ([#4205](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4205) )
- docs(integrations): Show how Python UDFs call Tracecat via ctx ([#4209](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4209) )
- feat(integrations): Add Cribl REST actions and MCP server ([#4214](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4214) )
- feat(enterprise+api): Add Bitwarden Secrets Manager secret store ([#4232](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4232) )
- docs(integrations): Add Connection Guides to Cheatsheets ([#4238](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4238) )
- docs(integrations): Split log archive setup into steps ([#4240](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4240) )
- docs(integrations): Move SSE-KMS setup to the AWS FAQ ([#4241](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4241) )


## Engine


- fix(engine): Log provider keys as strings ([#4197](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4197) )
- test(engine): Pin Temporal test server for sync lifecycle tests ([#4198](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4198) )
- feat(engine): Expose the workspace ID as ENV.workspace_id ([#4206](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4206) )


## API


- fix(api): Reject case-variant duplicate emails at user creation ([#3683](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3683) )
- fix(api): Return 503 for transient Temporal RPC errors ([#3700](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3700) )
- feat(rbac): Split Git sync into push and pull scopes ([#4006](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4006) )
- fix(api+ui): Name the action when an expression fails to parse ([#4208](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4208) )


## User interface


- fix(ui): Validate variable names in the create and edit forms ([#3987](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3987) )
- feat(ui): Type anywhere to write in the visible chat composer ([#4084](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4084) )


## Infrastructure


- fix(infra): Enforce tenant RLS on child tables ([#4196](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4196) )
- fix(infra): Pass the public app URL to the agent worker ([#4215](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4215) )
- feat(infra): Let Fargate pull ECR images and take extra env vars ([#4220](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4220) )
- ci: Run the table search lock tests ([#4223](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4223) )
- feat(infra): Configure login role names for tracecat db roles ([#4251](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4251) )


## Observability


- feat(logging): Export executor platform metrics ([#4249](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4249) )


## Documentation


- fix(docs): Group agent endpoints in the API reference ([#4231](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4231) )


**Full Changelog** :[1.5.2...1.6.0-alpha.1](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.5.2...1.6.0-alpha.1)
